_doc: Tier benchmark. ground_truth_source: manual_review = a human reviewed the project and evidence independently of the bot; algorithm_echo = expected value copied from current bot output (regression only, proves nothing about accuracy); unknown = no expectation. As of 2026-10-26 there are ZERO manual_review cases (manual_reviews table in hypebot.db is empty). To add ground truth: fill manual_review.manual_tier + reviewer + reviewed_at + evidence_urls (real public links you opened) + notes, and set ground_truth_source to manual_review. scripts/benchmark_tiers.py reports manual and echo agreement separately; accuracy may only be claimed from manual_review rows.
